source.author: verg
source.text: in segetem veluti cum flamma furentibus austris incidit, aut rapidus montano flumine torrens sternit agros, sternit sata laeta boumque labores, praecipitisque trahit silvas, stupet inscius alto accipiens sonitum saxi de vertice pastor.
source.text_original: in segetem veluti cum flamma furentibus austris / incidit, aut rapidus montano flumine torrens / sternit agros, sternit sata laeta boumque labores, / praecipitisque trahit silvas, stupet inscius alto / accipiens sonitum saxi de vertice pastor.
source.text_english: as when a flame, raging with the southern winds, falls upon a crop, or a rushing torrent from a mountain stream lays low the fields, lays low the joyful crops and the labors of the oxen, and sweeps away the forests, and the shepherd, unaware, stands stunned, hearing from a lofty cliff the sound of the falling rock.

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: omne dei rapidis nemus ingemit alis, strata Ceres, motusque niger sub praepete pontus.
reuse.text_original: omne dei rapidis nemus ingemit alis, / strata Ceres, motusque niger sub praepete pontus.
reuse.text_english: All the grove of the god groans with rapid wings; Ceres is laid low, and the black sea is stirred beneath the swift bird.
